verdict.rationale: Graphite is a code-review and stacked-PR platform, not purely an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question. Its first-party GT MCP is documented as letting AI agents automatically create stacked PRs. A probe confirmed the official MCP server docs page exists, and the pricing page lists MCP as a feature. missing for 10: setup/connection instructions for specific agent clients, documentation of the exposed tool set beyond stacked-PR creation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
